nextReadySlice.title: Synthetic build telemetry capture contract
failingProof: A failing proof shows the repository still lacks a deterministic, documented way to capture cold, no-op, and single-edit build or design-time telemetry for the synthetic scale fixture scenarios that now emit invalidation reports.
A failing proof shows Phase 0 still cannot publish reviewable `.binlog` or timing-summary artifacts from the same Tier 2 synthetic scenarios in a stable, machine-readable contract.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Stop again for review before locking broader benchmark or telemetry publication lanes if the first telemetry-capture slice suggests the shared envelope needs different cross-artifact fields.
